name: browser-q
description: AI web automation — navigate, interact, extract data from any website. Natural language task definition, session recording, visual monitoring, and credential vault integration.
shortDescription: AI web automation — navigate, interact, and extract data from any website.
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Navigate any website with natural language instructions
Take screenshots and monitor pages for visual changes
Extract structured data from web pages (tables, lists, text)
Fill forms and interact with web UIs autonomously
Session recording and replay for repeatable automations
Credential vault integration — passwords never stored in agent memory

navigation.name: Web Navigation
navigation.description: Navigate to any URL with intelligent page load detection and redirect handling.

screenshots.name: Screenshot Capture
screenshots.description: Capture full-page or element-specific screenshots with automatic storage.

extraction.name: Data Extraction
extraction.description: Extract structured data from web pages — tables, lists, links, text, and images.

formFilling.name: Form Filling
formFilling.description: Click elements, type text, and fill forms using CSS selectors or natural language descriptions.

monitoring.name: Visual Monitoring
monitoring.description: Schedule visual diff monitoring to detect when pages change.

sessionRecording.name: Session Recording
sessionRecording.description: Record and replay automation sequences for repeatable tasks.

futureFeatures: Credential vault integration with HITL login approval
Session recording and replay with self-healing
Visual diff monitoring with scheduled captures
Cross-agent browser requests (any agent can request browser actions)
Live session viewer with real-time screenshot feed
